hooks.command: jq -nc --argjson o '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"RTFM MANDATE (AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md, not optional). Before the first substantive tool call of this turn, if it touches a design decision, mechanism, milestone or campaign: (1) read docs/campaigns/README.md and the campaign document covering the work — each is written to be sufficient alone; (2) check docs/campaigns/research-*.md, the prior art may already be surveyed; (3) if an external project is cited, read its SOURCE (~/src/Strata-ref, ~/src/FreeToken-ref, ~/src/ninfer), not only its paper — where they disagree the code wins; (4) state the EVIDENCE CLASS (paper|code|measured-here) of every disposition you write; (5) a CONFIRMED/DEVIATION/UNSUPPORTED label is not evidence — check what it rested on; (6) a negative that was never tried is not verified. (7) an arcint negative counts against a reference technique only if it tested the same mechanism; a reference mechanism blocked by a DESIGN invariant or a CLAUDE.md rule is decided by the OPERATOR, with the measured price of each side (docs/campaigns/research-reference-audit.md). (8) correctness is judged at the answer, not at the bit: right facts, needle, task battery, and mean KL vs the reference at most 0.03 nats worse than the baseline arm (CLAUDE.md answer-level bar)."}}' '$o'
